# coolify_gitea_apps (Data Source)

Lists Gitea sources for the token's team, including system-wide sources. Requires Coolify >= v4.7.0. `is_connected` is true when the OAuth connection can deploy private repositories. Client secrets, access tokens, refresh tokens, and webhook secrets are not read into state. Filter names: uuid, name, organization, api_url, html_url, client_id, is_connected, is_system_wide, is_public, and team_id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_gitea_apps" "all" {}

output "connected_gitea_apps" {
  value = [for app in data.coolify_gitea_apps.all.gitea_apps : app.uuid if app.is_connected]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter results by field values. Multiple filters are ANDed together. Multiple values within a filter are ORed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `gitea_apps` (Attributes List) Gitea sources visible to the token's team. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gitea_apps))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The field name to filter by.
- `values` (Set of String) The values to match against. Multiple values are ORed.


<a id="nestedatt--gitea_apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gitea_apps`

Read-Only:

- `api_url` (String) Gitea API URL.
- `client_id` (String) OAuth client id. Null when the source has none.
- `created_at` (String) When the source was created.
- `custom_port` (Number) SSH port. Null when Coolify stored none.
- `custom_user` (String) SSH user Coolify uses for this source. Null when Coolify stored none.
- `html_url` (String) Gitea site URL.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier.
- `is_connected` (Boolean) True when both the access token and the refresh token are stored.
- `is_public` (Boolean) True when the source is a public Gitea.
- `is_system_wide` (Boolean) True when every team on the instance can use the source.
- `name` (String) Source name.
- `organization` (String) Repository owners this source allows, comma-separated. Null when every owner is allowed.
- `redirect_uri` (String) OAuth redirect URI. Null when the source has none.
- `team_id` (Number) Owning team id. Null when Coolify did not return one.
- `updated_at` (String) When the source was last updated.
- `uuid` (String) UUID. Pass this as gitea_app_uuid when creating an application from the source.
